calculation_role: independent Python diagnostic; native production EOS are not modified

analytic_control.identity: delta P = n^2*d(delta epsilon/n)/dn = (2/3)*delta epsilon at fixed composition

RG_SLY4.scope: exact public density nodes; explicit homogeneous phase=3; no interpolation
RG_SLY4.control_definition: Only nuclear kinetic K is split by species; the published interaction, rest masses and lepton prescription are unchanged.

constant_energy_shift_diagnostic.statement: A constant energy-per-baryon offset cannot remove a varying residual and changes no pressure. No offset was applied.

RG_SLY4.remaining_issue: A kinetic prescription can be tested and its composition effect measured; this does not identify the provider prescription or explain every pressure/energy residual.

GM_GM1.species: npe in every control; public provider specifies npe

rounding_control.definition: A linearized least-squares search within each printed Table II half-digit interval, followed by a full nonlinear evaluation at its result. This is a diagnostic, not an adopted retuning or a global impossibility proof.
rounding_control.weight_definition: Residual E/A divided by 1 MeV and P divided by 1 MeV fm^-3 have equal numerical weights; deterministic every-eighth training rows plus final row; remaining rows held out.

GM_GM1.conclusion_scope: Header masses do not establish kernel masses. A tested rounding box is not evidence that all source differences are explained by published precision.
